# Erdos.p683 — Erdős problem 683

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/683
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/683.lean`, theorem `erdos_683.variant.exp_sqrt`, AMS 11).

Standard heuristics suggest that $P(n, k) > e^{c\sqrt{k}}$ for some constant $c > 0$.

## Statement
∃ c > 0, ∀ n k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ n / 2 → P n k > Real.exp (c * Real.sqrt k)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
